subtasks.description: Define run/stage states including queued, running, completed, partial, failed, unavailable and insufficient evidence, with typed reasons.
Introduce immutable transcript revisions, evidence spans, analysis runs and model/prompt/schema provenance.
Make every finding reference existing authorized turns and original audio offsets; reject malformed references.
Exclude mock providers from production configuration and preserve explicit mock labels in any development fixtures.
Remove random/default analytics from production result serialization; unavailable metrics remain unavailable.
Expose quality, coverage and degradation consistently through API, UI, exports and usage eligibility rules.
